title: Almost-wise linear transform
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, and let $\mathbb F_2$ be the field with two elements. Set $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$ and $r=(k-1)d+1$. The almost-wise transform sends each vector $y\in\mathbb F_2^r$ to the row-vector product of $y$ with the executable Vandermonde matrix over $\mathbb F_2$ having $r$ rows and $n$ columns.
caveat: The payload does not define the executable Vandermonde matrix, so its entries cannot be stated self-containedly.
